brief: Start in a sterile white corridor with fluorescent lighting before entering a narrow chokepoint. Follow the path through a central hub containing a blue key door, then descend into dark service tunnels. Battle through enemy packs in a circular reactor chamber with glowing blue energy. Exit through a reinforced door back to the main facility.
pacing_notes: Build tension through lighting changes from sterile white to red alert, with combat teaching early and increasing enemy density toward the reactor arena.

rubric_hints.navigation: Corridors are axis-aligned with clear directional flow; key door requires specific item collection
rubric_hints.pacing: Slow build-up through safe zones, then rapid escalation into combat-heavy sections
rubric_hints.mechanics: Blue key door introduces a resource management element; shotgun teaching provides weapon familiarity
rubric_hints.affordances: Reactor core provides visual guidance and dynamic lighting effects for atmosphere
rubric_hints.narrative: UAC facility progression from sterile security to critical reactor zone, with red alert tone conveying urgency
